To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the hybrid reality of a city center is a suitable context for mixed reality games that combine the real and virtual worlds, and that the size of the game has a significant impact on the gameplay.
hybrid reality game players are more likely to enjoy the gameplay when the game is played in the real city center rather than in a virtual game world.
players preferred to tag locations in the real world and that the virtual game world is a marginal addition to the real game world.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and evaluation of location based hybrid reality games.
the playful appropriation of hybrid realities, and the design implications for the development of hybrid reality games.
how hybrid reality games can be designed to support playful appropriation of urban spaces.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hybrid reality is a valuable addition to the game but the real streets are still the most preferred place for playing.
hybrid reality games should focus on the real world and not on the virtual world.
the virtual game world is an important part of SAG but it should be designed and used carefully to complement and enhance the gameplay in the real world.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
hybrid reality games are a promising new genre of games but the design and evaluation of hybrid games requires a new set of design principles and evaluation methods.
the virtual game world is not necessary to enjoy a location based mixed-reality game.
the hybrid reality of the city and its virtual replica can be used to support playful appropriation of a city center, but the added value of a virtual replica is limited.
The main takeaway from our work is that
location based hybrid reality games are best played on real streets and that the size and scale of the game are important factors in the gameplay.

the design of location based mixed reality games should be informed by the players' experience with the hybrid reality and the game should be designed to support the players' appropriation of the hybridity.
the virtual game world is not necessarily needed in location based games that are played in real streets.
